problem.statement: Field workers need to capture structured notes when connectivity is unreliable.
problem.context: Work occurs in locations with intermittent network access.

solution.summary: A local-first structured note application that synchronizes when connectivity returns.
solution.description: Users create templates, capture notes offline, and resolve synchronization conflicts.
solution.core_value: Reliable structured capture without requiring continuous connectivity.

use_cases.scenario: Creates and saves a note while offline.
use_cases.expected_result: The note is durably stored locally and marked for synchronization.

mvp.name: Offline note capture
mvp.description: Create and edit notes without network access.

functional.statement: The system must save notes locally while offline.
acceptance_criteria: A saved note remains available after restart.

non_functional.statement: The application must not lose acknowledged local writes.
acceptance_criteria: Fault-injection tests show no acknowledged write loss.

technical: Must run in a modern browser.
legal: Must provide a data export path.
economic: MVP should run on low-cost infrastructure.

evidence.claim: Browser storage and synchronization are technically feasible.

hypotheses: Offline persistence reduces duplicate manual transcription.

success_criteria: Most participants resolve a seeded conflict without assistance.

architecture.data_flow: User input is stored locally, queued, synchronized, and reconciled.
architecture.scaling_strategy: Scale synchronization services horizontally by account partition.

technology.selection_rationale: Browser-native local storage and a typed client support the offline workflow.

data.storage_rationale: Local durable storage with a synchronized server copy.

interfaces.errors: Use typed conflict and validation errors.

flows.name: Capture offline note
flows.description: Open template, enter data, save locally, and view sync state.

security.authorization: Users can access only their permitted notes.

threats.name: Lost device
threats.description: A device may expose locally cached data.

mitigations.name: Local encryption
mitigations.description: Encrypt sensitive local storage where platform support permits.

security.secrets_management: Do not store server secrets in the client.

deployment.development: Local browser client and test service.
deployment.migrations: Version local schemas and synchronize migrations.
deployment.recovery: Replay queued changes after service recovery.

tasks.title: Implement local note persistence
tasks.description: Create durable local storage and recovery behavior.

risks.description: Conflict resolution may be too difficult for users.
risks.mitigation: Prototype and test conflict flows before implementation lock.

open_questions.question: Which conflict types are common in the target workflow?

maturity.readiness_basis: Problem, users, MVP scope, technical requirements, architecture, interfaces, security, testing, deployment, and tasks are specified. Market feedback has not started and is not an acceptance gate.
